verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships a built-in `local-ai chat` agent that runs commands and reads files behind an approval gate, plus MCP-based agentic capabilities configurable via the web UI, and a built-in web interface for configuring AI agents — this is a first-party built-in assistant, not a bolt-on tool. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs, and more detail on assistant task scope/limits.
